_comment: Prophetic radiance mixer — 4K probes, workgroup=64, dispatch=64. SHIMMED UNIFORM: ProphecyParams = { probe_count: u32, sun_dir_xyz: 3*f32, sun_rgb: 3*f32, confidence_floor: f32 } = 32 bytes. capture-bench has no native packer for this exact mixed u32/f32 shape, so it's hand-packed via uniform-u32-tuple with f32 fields encoded as their IEEE-754 u32 bit patterns. Bit patterns used here: sun_dir=(0,1,0) → (0, 0x3f800000=1065353216, 0); sun_rgb=(1,1,1) → (1065353216, 1065353216, 1065353216); confidence_floor=0.05 → 0x3d4ccccd=1028443341.
section: Renderer-facing application of the SNN — converts per-probe spike rates into packed RadianceProbe output (rgb, confidence, world-space position) for the downstream R3F lighting blend.
